A little more clarity

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Need help with something else?
We’re a message away.

Ask us on WhatsApp ↗
How do I request a quote?

Use Get a Quote, fill in your details, and continue on WhatsApp. Review and send the message to start your enquiry. You can also call us.

What documents are needed for motor insurance?

Typically, your vehicle registration certificate (RC), existing policy for a renewal, and any identity or other documents requested by the insurer. Requirements vary; we can guide you.

Can you help renew an expired policy?

Contact us with your existing policy and vehicle details. Inspection or additional requirements may apply. Cover starts only as stated in the new policy; do not assume protection during a lapse.

What is the difference between third-party and package insurance?

Third-party insurance covers eligible liability to other people or their property. Package insurance generally combines third-party liability with own-damage cover, subject to policy terms and exclusions.

What is a No Claim Bonus?

A No Claim Bonus (NCB) is a discount on the own-damage premium for eligible claim-free years. Eligibility, transfer, and the effect of a claim depend on the policy and insurer’s rules.

How do I get claim assistance?

Contact Procare promptly with your policy and incident details. We can guide you on intimation, documents, inspection coordination, and insurer follow-up. The insurer assesses and settles the claim.

How do I enquire about health insurance?

Choose Health Insurance in the quote form or message us on WhatsApp. Share your requirements so we can help explain available options, waiting periods, and exclusions.

Can I contact Procare through WhatsApp?

Yes. Message +91 9061 6666 07 using any WhatsApp button on this website. Documents should be shared directly within WhatsApp.
